items.title: Meta Ads: $349.67 spend, 29 leads, $12.06 CPL — Flooring Problems
items.summary: Ingest resumed after a 15-day gap (last successful run 2026-08-14 covered 2026-08-13); per policy the window was widened to the capped maximum of 7 days (2026-08-23 to 2026-08-29) rather than the standard single day, so these are 7-day totals, not yesterday's. Across that window Meta spent $349.67 on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 29 leads at $12.06 CPL — below the 7-day-prior baseline of $13.45 CPL (2026-08-16 to 2026-08-22, $349.74 / 26 leads). Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Gap since last successful run: the last meta-ads.json was written 2026-08-14 (covering 2026-08-13), a 15-day gap. Per policy this run widened the pull to the capped maximum of 7 days (2026-08-23 to 2026-08-29) instead of the standard 'yesterday' window — the file above reports a 7-day rollup, not a single day. Days 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-22 were NOT pulled or backfilled (out of scope per instructions not to backfill 15 days of history); if day-level detail for that stretch is needed, it requires a separate deliberate pull.

Baseline adjustment: the CPL baseline was pulled from the 7 days immediately preceding the gap-window (2026-08-16 to 2026-08-22) rather than the default trailing-7-days-ending-yesterday, because the default would have been identical to the primary window itself (a meaningless self-comparison). This is a one-off adjustment for the gap day, not a change to the standard baseline call — worth confirming this reasoning is acceptable.

Recurring (also flagged on the 2026-08-14 run, still unresolved): Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions show lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads), each matching the counted lead value exactly in both windows pulled today (29 in-window, 26 in baseline). No discrepancy in the counted totals, but per the agent's trap note this should be reviewed for whether the script's lead-action set needs extending — not hand-patched here.
